'''Vortex Squadron''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[T-47 sandspeeder/Legends|T-47 sandspeeder]] unit led by [[Harl Bess]] and stationed at [[Arda Base]]. It was in operation by the time of the [[Battle of the Gauntlet (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of the Gauntlet]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], and the [[T-47 sandspeeder/Legends|sandspeeders]] were used to mainly conducted patrol operations around the base.

{{Military-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Vortex Squadron appears in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] adventure ''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]''.
